title: Manis Grafika
subtitle: A website as refined as the prayer books they print.
description: Manis Grafika is a printing and publishing house in Solo that makes premium religious books such as Yasin, Tahlil, and Majmu Syarif. Its books are known for careful craftsmanship and quality materials, and the website had to show that same care online.

content.label: Problem
content.heading: The books only made sense in person.
content.content: Customers had no way to see cover materials, print details, or sample pages online, so the quality that sets Manis Grafika apart never came through on a screen.
goals: Let customers see the craftsmanship online.
Show materials and print detail without clutter.
Guide visitors toward a consultation, where orders start.

content.label: Challenge
content.heading: Selling something you need to touch.
content.content: Premium prayer books sell on the paper, the cover, and the finish. The site had to carry that on a screen, with full product details, while staying as quiet as the books themselves.

content.label: Solution
content.heading: Let the photography lead.
content.content: A minimal layout gives each book room. Every book has its own page with a curated gallery, material specifications, and one path forward: a consultation, which is how Manis Grafika takes orders.

content.label: Result
content.heading: Live at manisgrafika.id.
content.content: Customers can now look closely at every book before they get in touch.

points.title: Scope
points.text: A detail page for every book, with a gallery, materials, and a consultation call to action.
